summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) after show_cursor, gated on is_terminal and returning bool; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Not verified: tests, Black, and mypy were not run, per instructions.
